description: Sample name (file names, report title).
EDIT. UNFILTERED tissue-cut input - stereo: tissue-cut Stereo-seq h5ad; visiumhd: Space Ranger binned_outputs/square_XXXum folder. A relative path is relative to the folder of this file.
EDIT. Run folder, created if missing: tables + figures -> {outdir}/figures; analysis h5ad -> {outdir}/{sample}.marker_pipeline.h5ad.
stereo or visiumhd.
Optional other path for the analysis h5ad (empty = {outdir}/{sample}.marker_pipeline.h5ad).
Cell types that get the any-marker region DE: all, or cell types from marker_sets.csv separated by ; (slow on large regions).
Co-localization pairs A:B separated by ; (e.g. NK:Neuron; Mast:Fibroblasts), or all for every pair; empty = none.
true = continue after a data-quality STOP (exploration only; the verdict stays STOP).
true = also show plots interactively (notebooks).
Terminal detail: INFO (progress + one line per result), WARNING (warnings only) or DEBUG (everything). {outdir}/marqual_st.log always has everything.
Distance between neighbouring bins in obsm['spatial'] units (Stereo-seq bin50: 50; not used for Visium HD).
Bin width in um, only labels distances (Stereo-seq bin50: 25; Visium HD 8 um: 8).
Remove bins with total counts < min_counts. 600 / 6 / 20 is the recommended Stereo-seq bin50 filter - keep it fixed across samples.
Remove genes detected in < min_cells bins.
Remove bins with mitochondrial % >= pct_mt.
Data-quality gate: CAUTION when >= this % of bins is filtered out (the run continues; warning in the report). Samples that ran well lost 2.7%, 9.8%, 23.1%.
STOP when >= this % of bins is filtered out: the run ends after technical QC (maps of the UNFILTERED bins) + report.
Also STOP when fewer bins than this are left after the filter.
Tissue sections on the chip; > 1: the N largest pieces -> obs['tissue_section'] (S1, S2 ...).
Treat sections as a technical variable: true or false; empty = true when num_tissue > 1.
Random gene sets for the Moran's I null test and the co-localization test.
Random gene sets for co-localization by distance.
Random seed.
High-confidence niche = bins above this quantile of the smoothed score (0.95 = top 5%; 0.90 = top 10%).
Top DE genes per direction (tables, dot plot).
Combinations of cell types with fewer bins -> Mix.
Plots use at most this many colors (Mix included).
Optional colors label=color separated by ; (e.g. NK=#1f77b4; Mix=#9467bd); empty = default colors.
Optional gene-pair step (marqual-st gene-pairs): gene pairs A:B separated by ; (e.g. GNLY:ATP8A2; CD3E:CD8A).
Permutations for the bivariate Moran's I of the gene-pair step.
